description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldDateTime class, which extends SugarWidgetReportField, to handle date and time widget functionalities in SugarCRM and SuiteCRM. It includes methods for filtering, date expansion, query generation, display formatting, and dealing with date/time in reports and user interfaces.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldDateTime
classes.description: A widget class for handling date/time report fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, providing filtering, display, query, and date manipulation functionalities.

methods.name: getReporter
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the reporter attribute.

methods.name: getAssignedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the assigned user bean based on report definition.

methods.name: queryFilterOn
methods.description: Generates filter query based on input date, handling date and datetime.

methods.name: expandDate
methods.description: Converts date-only values to include time component, handling special macros like 'today'.

methods.name: queryFilterBefore
methods.description: Filters records before a specified date.

methods.name: queryFilterAfter
methods.description: Filters records after a specified date.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_str
methods.description: Filters records that do not equal a specific date/time.

methods.name: get_users_current_date_time
methods.description: Returns current user date/time in formatted string or timestamp.

methods.name: get_db_date
methods.description: Returns a date string adjusted for user timezone, offset by days and within start/end times.

methods.name: get_start_end_date_filter
methods.description: Constructs SQL filter string for date range.

methods.name: queryDateOp
methods.description: Builds SQL snippet for date/time comparison operations.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Provides the current date/time in user's timezone.

methods.name: queryDay
methods.description: Creates filter for a whole day.

methods.name: getQuarterFilter
methods.description: Generates filter for a specific quarter, with optional modification.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Generates GROUP BY clause based on qualifier.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Generates ORDER BY clause based on qualifier.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Formats date/time for display in list views.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Formats date/time for display in report list.

methods.name: querySelect
methods.description: Generates SELECT clause for report queries.

methods.name: displayListday
methods.description: Returns display value for day list.

methods.name: displayListyear
methods.description: Returns display value for year list.

methods.name: displayListmonth
methods.description: Returns display value for month list.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: HTML select input for date filters.

methods.name: hasTime
methods.description: Determines if a date string includes time component.
